title.narrative: Improving Electoral and Political Processes for Change in Sudan

description.narrative: (Sudan): Although recent developments are helping Sudanese authorities and political and civil society actors move in the direction of a political agreement, the evolving political and increasingly dire economic environment are challenging for program implementation. Given the unsteady nature of the economy, continued political tensions and divisions, increased conflict in several states, and continued security risks, the country is highly susceptible to dramatic shifts and crises. This program will support U.S. foreign policy and the ICS goal, "Sudan makes necessary preparations and develops capacity for free and fair elections that promote popular participation from across Sudan." FY2022 funds will address priority needs but not limited to:.Supporting a transitional legislative council.. .Building the institutional capacity of the election administration by supporting the establishment of an electoral commission and related electoral management bodies.. .Strengthening political parties and their internal structures through training sessions and reaching out to traditionally marginalized populations to ensure increased representation of those groups.. .Elevating women voices in national dialogues, electoral and political processes by continually assessing the opportunities for and barriers to women's participation based on Gender Equity and Equality Action GEEA....
